summary: nanoGPT is a small PyTorch codebase for training, fine-tuning and sampling GPT-style language models, including loading OpenAI's GPT-2 weights. It includes data preparation scripts, a training loop, a text generator and config files.

options.label: GPT model in one file
options.what: How a GPT is built from token and position embeddings, stacked blocks of attention and MLP, layer norm, and an output head.

options.label: Causal self-attention
options.what: How each token attends only to earlier tokens, using multiple heads and a mask.

options.label: Sampling next tokens
options.what: How generation repeatedly predicts the next token and appends it, and how a model is loaded and prompted.

options.label: The training loop
options.what: How batches are drawn, loss is computed and evaluated, and gradients are applied, with options for multi-GPU training.

options.label: Turning text into token files
options.what: How raw text becomes binary arrays of integer ids, by character or by GPT-2 byte-pair encoding.

options.label: Config files and overrides
options.what: How a tiny script overrides global variables from config files and command-line flags.

cannot.why: The repository has no test files.
